code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
            continue
        if not (all(g[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                all(g[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                all(g[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)) and
                all(g[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
            continue
        pat = [[g[r][c] == color for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
               for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)]
        if any(any(row) for row in pat):
            frames.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, pat))
        else:
            frames.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, None))
    sources = [f for f in frames if f[5] is not None]
    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1, pat in frames:
        if pat is not None:
            continue
        th, tw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        candidates = []
        for src in sources:
            sh, sw = len(src[5]), len(src[5][0])
            if sh <= th and sw <= tw:
                candidates.append(( (th-sh)+(tw-sw), src))
        if not candidates:
            continue
        _, src = min(candidates, key=lambda x: x[0])
        pat = src[5]
        sh, sw = len(pat), len(pat[0])
        ro, co = (th-sh)//2, (tw-sw)//2
        for i in range(sh):
            for j in range(sw):
                if pat[i][j]:
                    g[r0 + 1 + ro + i][c0 + 1 + co + j] = color
    return g
'''
